interpretation: A source-reviewed delivery/retirement snapshot for all 20 baseline domains, not a capability registry, executed-test receipt, numerical qualification, performance result or assertion about a newer HEAD. Each row explicitly records current method/backend/representation/property/spin/approximation audit_axes; these are audit domains, not Cartesian capability products. The linked historical baseline remains unchanged. Scoped call_paths connect caller and callee files and classify Python's role on each edge; null denotes a wholly native edge. These are navigation pointers, not an exhaustive static call graph or executable admission rules. Each delivered scope is conditional on the selected installed build and native prepared context. Listed tests are evidence locations, not claims that they ran in this audit. Original baseline IDs remain stable even when their historical names describe Python owners that have since migrated. Capability admission and independent source-matched qualification remain separate authorities.
